rules.single_or_small_set_request: If the general snapshot is older than snapshot_max_age_minutes, automatically trigger on-demand refresh for the requested whitelisted chat(s) before answering.
rules.broad_request: Use the rolling 192-hour general snapshot for broad multi-source analysis unless the user explicitly requires near-real-time completeness.
rules.fresh_snapshot: If the general snapshot age is within snapshot_max_age_minutes, answer from it without on-demand refresh.
rules.fallback: If on-demand refresh fails, answer from the newest available general snapshot and explicitly state its generated_at time.
rules.user_interaction: Never ask the user to choose a mode. Fetch strategy is selected automatically.
